objective_statement: find the leading input words for which the permutation reproduces the target in its trailing words exactly; the leading output words are unconstrained

program.name: Poseidon Cryptanalysis Initiative
program.redistribution: parameters and objective are published on the program's page; the round constants are derived, not redistributed

verifier: the program's own verifier; this crate generates no system for this objective and so has nothing to check
notes: Perm(X_1..X_7, 0) = (Y_1..Y_7, 0) over 2^64 - 2^32 + 1 with a degree-7 S-box, the 40-bit tier, listed as unsolved on 2026-11-05. The lower tiers of this family were claimed in April and May 2025.
